title: Unipolar Concept Activation & Neutral Hold (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `unipolar` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Activates a single positive concept direction (cover >= 0.85) while simultaneously holding neutral samples stationary (neu_hold >= 0.85) and preventing off-caption leakage (off_caption <= 0.05).
failure_mode: Unanchored critic logits or aggressive generator steps push neutral points along the active pole, violating neu_hold or causing off-caption contamination.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `unipolar` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
